title: Briefing for 2026-10-03
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-03: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.

The September jobs report will be released Friday. Here's what to expect. Fed’s preferred gauge showed core inflation at 3.0% in August, much lighter than expected. The Fed's main inflation measure will be released Wednesday. Here's what to expect. America's Canadian import restrictions come into force. Here are the products barred from entry.

'I was not going to let others die' - pilot of Flydubai flight describes cockpit attack by co-pilot. Spanish PM Sánchez loses key housing crisis vote after eviction of woman, 87.

outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
